question.says: Anything you want to know or have done. `look at <repo>` reads any repo first.

change.says: A fix or feature in an app, Shipify, or a repo on any of your accounts. Merging its PR ships it.

new.says: An idea for a new app, site or package. You get a plan to approve.

remember.says: A note Shipify keeps in mind for every task, or forgets. Saved at once, with no AI.

repeat.says: A reminder, a job, or a check, on a schedule. Say “stop repeating” to end it.

operate.says: Release to production, take an app down or bring it back, or roll back.

help.short: Ask, build and change your apps from here. Approvals stay on GitHub.
guide: Send me anything (or /ask …): a question, an app idea, a change to an app. Each message starts a task, answered here.
To carry a task on, reply to any of its messages, or start with its number: #12 and your words. #12 alone brings it back.
/use picks your model: new tasks start with it. For one task only: #12 use opus, or #12 /use for buttons.
/tasks lists your tasks, /help shows everything, with examples. Approvals stay on GitHub.
examples: task 12 uses Opus at High from your next message; nothing runs
with your words on the lines below: task 12 switches, then asks
with your words below, sent fresh: a new task on Sonnet; your model stays
look at acme/tool what does it do?
reads that repo, read-only, and answers
a change to another of your repos, its own way: a PR, nothing of Shipify's added
a change to a repo on another of your accounts (pnpm ship bot repos acme): a PR its own way, against its default branch
